card.name: Small words inside trial-result phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words or number pieces inside clinical-trial reporting phrases, such as 'Difference in Number of Patients', 'median time to', and 'per 100 patients'. The marked word sits just before the thing being counted or timed.

modes.label: Linking words in table headings
modes.description: Words like 'in', 'of' and 'to' in headings and phrases about differences, counts, or time to an event.
modes.example: Age Range Drug-Placebo Difference<< in>> Number of Patients of Suicidal Thoughts

modes.label: Rate denominators
modes.description: The digit 0 in 'per 100 patients' or 'per 100 patient-years' event rates.
modes.example: herpes simplex infections were reported in 17 subjects (6.8 per 10<<0>> patient‑years) treated with SOT

modes.label: Timing words
modes.description: Words giving a time point or interval in monitoring or follow-up statements.
